8 Things You Shouldn’t Say to Someone With Memory Problems

When someone develops memory problems , their loved ones often reach for the family photo album—and start quizzing them. Who’s that? Where were we? Come on, Mom, you know this one. Dr. Carolyn Fredericks hears about this approach from people who are new to caregiving and hoping to help.
